title: From Food to Energy · Nutrient Flow
description: How the food you eat is broken down and used by the body.

nodes.label: Digestion
nodes.detail: Mouth, stomach and intestines break food into tiny pieces.

nodes.label: Absorption
nodes.detail: Nutrients pass into the blood through the small intestine.

nodes.label: Carbs → energy
nodes.detail: Used immediately for play and study.

nodes.label: Fats → stored energy
nodes.detail: Stored to use later and to keep the body warm.

nodes.label: Proteins → growth
nodes.detail: Build and repair muscles, hair, skin.

nodes.label: Vitamins → protection
nodes.detail: Keep eyes, blood, bones, and immunity healthy.

nodes.label: Fibre → smooth digestion
nodes.detail: Helps remove waste from the body.
